trigger.eyebrow: A timely reason to improve the experience
trigger.title: Digital instructions are becoming part of the machinery conversation.
trigger.body: From 20 January 2027, the EU Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 allows instructions for use to be supplied digitally if its conditions are met. They must clearly identify the model, be accessible, downloadable and printable, and stay online for the machine’s expected lifetime and at least 10 years. Paper instructions can be requested at purchase; essential safety information for non-professional use has additional paper requirements. Video can support understanding, but it does not replace required instructions or establish compliance.

faqs.question: Does the Machinery Regulation require video instructions?
faqs.answer: No. The regulation allows instructions to be supplied in digital form under specified conditions, but it does not require video. Video can be an additional explanatory resource; it does not replace the required instructions.

faqs.question: Can digital instructions replace paper instructions?
faqs.answer: The regulation permits digital instructions if its conditions are met: users must be able to access, download, save and print them, and the instructions must remain online for the expected lifetime of the machine and at least 10 years. If requested at purchase, paper instructions must be provided free within one month. Essential safety information for non-professional users has additional paper requirements. Confirm the application with your compliance team.

faqs.question: What should the sample video show?
faqs.answer: Use a real, approved machine reference and focus on one audience question: what the machine does, how a workflow fits together or what a new customer should understand first. Product and safety claims need review by your team.

faqs.question: Can the same story support sales and customer education?
faqs.answer: The core product story can be adapted for different moments. A sales overview, a setup orientation and a service explainer should each be shaped for their audience and purpose.

faqs.question: How do you keep a machinery visual accurate?
faqs.answer: Start with approved product references and have product experts review the storyboard and final visual. For closer machinery fidelity, request CAD or measurement data where available; never promise engineering accuracy from a few photographs alone.

faqs.question: Where can a short explainer be used?
faqs.answer: A reviewed cut can be shared in an email or chat, paired with a proposal, shown at an event or embedded on a product page. Platform-specific crops and captions should be prepared for each use.
